tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad pas/ dus gcig gi tshe 'od tshogs kyi dbus na rin po che'i khri cig gi steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gnyis g.yas g.yon du gnas pa mngon sum gzigs te gtso bo'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min// khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min// 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min// zhes gsungs pa'i don la dpyad pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba'i blo sbyong du 'du bar dgongs te/ chos thams cad la nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no// sa māpta mi thi// ༄༅// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*// thugs rje can gyi yi dam lha// snying nas skyabs su mchi lags kyi// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos min gyi spyod pa dgos rgyu med// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa la// zhen pa bzhin bral gyi gdams ngag 'tshal// de khyed kyi snyan du gsol bar

mchod brjod dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba bstan no/ bgyi// tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min// 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min// 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min// dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen par// tshul khrims dang thos bsam bsgom pa gsum// tshe 'di la dmigs nas bsgrub pa de// chos pa min gyi bshol la zhog /thog mar tshul khrims bshad tsam na// mtho ris bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// thar pa bsgrub pa'i them skas can// sdug bsngal spong ba'i gnyen po can// tshul khrims la med thabs mi gda' ste// tshe 'di la zhen pa'i tshul khrims de// chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// tshul khrims ngan la gshe ba can// tshul khrims ldan la phrag dog can// rang gi tshul khrims ngo phag can// ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i sa bon can// bcos ma'i tshul khrims bshol la zhog /thos bsam byed pa'i gang zag de// shes bya bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me can// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam rgyus can// chos kyi sku yi sa bon can// thos bsam la med thabs mi gda' ste// tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam de// nga rgyal bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can// thos bsam dman la brnyas pa can// thos bsam ldan la phrag dog can// 'khor dang longs spyod tshol ba can// ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// chos brgyad kyi thos bsam bshol la zhog /sgom pa bgyid pa'i gang zag kun// nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po can// thar lam bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i longs spyod can// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon can// sgom pa la med thabs mi gda' ste// tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i sgom pa de// dben par bsdad kyang 'du 'dzi can// long gtam smra ba'i kha ton can// thos bsam byed la skur ba can// sgom pa gzhan la phrag dog can// rang gi sgom pa rnam g.yeng can// chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan bshol la zhog

'di yan chad kyi/ mngon pa mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa'i// bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes gsungs pa'i don la yang dag dang ltar snang gi dbye ba dngos su bstan to// dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom tshul shugs las bstan no// mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la// khams gsum la zhen pa spang yang 'tshal// khams gsum la zhen pa spong ba la// 'khor ba'i nyes pa dran par 'tshal// dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de// ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin// de legs par bsams na skyi sha 'bung*// thog tu babs na bsran thabs med// spong ba'i dge ba mi bsgrub par// ngan song gi so nam byed byed po// de gang na 'dug kyang the le le// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsams tsa na// mtho ris ngan 'gror 'gro ba yod// brgya byin tha mal du skye ba yod// nyi zla mun par 'gro ba yod// sgyur rgyal bran du skye ba yod// de lung la brten nas yid ches kyang*// phal pas rtogs par mi nus pas// rang snang mi yi 'gyur ba ltos// mi phyug po sprang por 'gro yin 'dug /kha drag po zhan por 'gro yin 'dug /mi mang po gcig tu 'gro yin 'dug /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab// 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsams tsa na// bya ba'i las la zin pa med// mi mang yang sdug la nyung yang sdug /nor phyug kyang sdug la ltogs kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad// grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi// shi yang grabs la zin pa med// tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'jug /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po la// zhen par byed rnams the le le/ 'di yan chad kyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dngos su bstan nas/ las 'bras kyi blang dor shugs las bstan no// zhen pa bral na mya ngan 'da'// mya ngan 'das na bde ba thob// zhen pa bzhi bral nyams kyi dbyangs// bdag gcig pu thar bas phan rgyu med// khams gsum sems can pha ma yin// pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag

/bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le// khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin// bdag gi bsod nams sems can khyer// bsod nams 'di yi byin rlabs kyis// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas 'di yan chad kyis rgyu byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa shugs las bstan nas/ 'bras bu bdag gzhan brje ba dngos su bstan no/ shog /bdag ji ltar 'dug kyang chos nyid kyi ngang*// 'dzin dang bcas la grol ba med// de yang zhib tu bshad tsam na// yod par 'dzin la thar pa med// med par 'dzin la mtho ris med// gnyis kar 'dzin pa mi shes pas// gnyis med kyi ngang la gang dgar 'di yan chad kyis rtag chad kyi lta ba spangs nas zung 'jug gnyis med la blo 'jog tshul spyir bstan no/ zhog /chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin// phywa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa// 'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma tshol bar// sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar 'di yan chad kyis byang sems sems tsam pa dang thun mong ba'i lam rim bstan nas/ theg chen dbu ma pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam ni/ zhog /snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang*// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi// gnas lugs brjod par mi shes kyi// brjod bral gyi ngang la gang dgar zhog 'di yan chad kyis zhi gnas bsgom tshul shugs las bstan nas/ lhag mthong bsgom tshul la/ yul snang sems su bsgrub pa dang*/ de sgyu mar bsgrub pa dang*/ de rang bzhin med pa/ rten 'brel dang*/ brjod bral du gtan la phab nas/ spros bral zung 'jug bsgom pa dngos su bstan no/ /zhen pa bzhi bral bshad pa yi// dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis// 'gro ba bdun po ma lus pa// sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog 'dis bsngo ba dang 'bras bu bstan no/ /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
